module: Small editor window "Camera Transform" (Camera menu). It reads the camera position/rotation as JSON (commands.getCameraTransformJson), lets you edit it or copy it to the clipboard, and teleport the free camera to an entered JSON (commands.setFreeCameraTransformJson).
notes: The text buffer is 512 characters (im.ArrayChar(512)): a longer JSON would be truncated.
The module only exports hooks; onEditorActivated and onEditorDeactivated are empty.

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the window: "Get Camera Transform", "GoTo" and "Copy" buttons, and a text field containing the transform JSON. Called every frame by the editor.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Adds the "Camera Transform" menu entry (Camera group) and registers the 600x200 window.

onEditorActivated.desc: Called when the editor is activated; does nothing.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Called when the editor is deactivated; does nothing.
